architecture.shared_input: Verified deterministic chart facts plus pre-question context; no author verdicts or future feedback
architecture.baseline: smoothed event-weighted prior and context-only logistic regression
architecture.calibration: reserved event-group calibration; untouched test; prospective external cohort required before practical probability claims
architecture.runtime: local non-LLM inference; phone integration is a separate future change

targets.meaning: Specific item reported recovered by last book feedback, with unequal or unknown follow-up
targets.must_not_display_as: eventual recovery probability or recovery within N days

targets.meaning: Separate probability of an independently ascertained condition at each predefined body region; simultaneous regions allowed
targets.label_requirement: specified anatomical taxonomy, assessment at query time, ascertainment source, complete versus partial examination
targets.unknown: an unmentioned or unexamined region is not a negative label
targets.training_support_v1: contract only; binary trainer may train one region with adequate observed positive/negative labels

targets.meaning: Distribution over severity at a declared assessment time under a prespecified clinical grading system
targets.label_requirement: same condition-specific grading criteria; do not convert symbolic scores or later death into initial clinical severity
targets.training_support_v1: contract only; multiclass trainer supports a category distribution, ordinal-specific fitting not implemented

targets.meaning: P(recovery by horizon), P(death by horizon), P(still unresolved at horizon)
targets.label_requirement: initial assessment date, precisely defined recovery endpoint, recovery/death date or interval, last observation date, treatment context
targets.unknown: still hospitalized at last follow-up is right-censored; death is a competing endpoint
targets.training_support_v1: risk aggregation implemented; censoring-aware fitting and dataset not implemented

targets.meaning: Direction from a coordinate reference declared BEFORE prediction, at a declared target time
targets.label_requirement: reference coordinates or explicit anchor, actual item coordinates/direction, target time, confirmation source
targets.unknown: unknown direction is a missing label; a moving stolen item's recovery direction is not its location at query time
targets.training_support_v1: generic multiclass trainer; no qualified direction dataset exported

targets.meaning: Distribution across a declared candidate set such as home, vehicle, workplace, outdoors and outside_candidates
targets.label_requirement: candidate locations declared before searching, target time, observed location, movement history
targets.unknown: a drawer is conditional on being in a room; do not multiply marginal direction/room/container scores
targets.training_support_v1: single-level multiclass training available; hierarchical conditional fitting not implemented

targets.meaning: Probability item recovered by 1/3/7/30 days under a declared recovery definition
targets.label_requirement: query time, recovery date or interval, last searched/observed time; distinguish temporary nonrecovery from permanent loss
targets.training_support_v1: contract only; censoring-aware fitting not implemented

evaluation.incremental_signal: Same heldout events: context-only versus identical context plus chart. A chart model must demonstrate improvement before claiming chart information adds predictive value.
